name: Highland Hides
objectiveText: Return 4 Thicket Raptor Hides to James Halloran , the tanner, in Menethil Harbor. Thicket Raptor Hide  ( 4 )

comments.body:
Prerequisite: Complete Young Crocolisk Skin by James Halloran in Menethil Harbor

There is no need to do Daily Delivery beforehand.
replies: This quest shows up along with[https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=471/apprentices-duties] but you do not have to take it. There is no portal icon as if this is a dungeon-only quest; however, you can finish this quest inside Excavation Site.
Are you saying Young Crocolisk Skin HAS to be completed for this quest to unlock? Others are saying you don't so I'm confused.
I had to complete Young Crocolisk Skins before I was able to get this quest.
